QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_55

question.text: The SIA assesses a reported 35% decrease in crime rate in the Niwas case. The BEST means of verification is:

answer.text: Niwas project documents, beneficiary interviews / surveys, field visits, and comparison against baseline / trend data where available

explanation.text: The Logic: The Niwas case supports the 35% decrease figure and the use of beneficiary interviews and field visits. General guidance supports comparison against baseline and trend data, so the SIA should triangulate project documents, beneficiary interviews/surveys, field visits and available trend data. The Trap: SE narrative, entertainment content and broker opinions are not audit evidence. Note: Document the basis of comparison (project documents, interviews, visits, trend data) so users can assess attribution to the programme.
